title: Patch: a GIGA Joro or Lava Golem is summoned only where all four of its zones are free, so neither is lost when the one zone picked for it is too small
thread:
**Issue #4990 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4990: Patch: a GIGA Joro or Lava Golem is summoned only where all four of its zones are free, so neither is lost when the one zone picked for it is too small
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Joro waits in your hand and jumps onto the board to take an enemy Spell aimed at one of your Units. A player can make Joro GIGA while it is in hand: Plesiosize turns the free 1/1 into a 9/9 GIGA, and GIGA-ify also works. A GIGA card needs four free zones. Today the game still picks a single free zone for it. When the zones beside that one are taken (a Trap set behind it, or the free zone is the last lane), the card cannot go there. By then it has already left the hand, so it ends up nowhere: Joro is gone from the game and the enemy Spell is redirected to a card that no longer exists.

Once this is built, a GIGA Joro jumps into the leftmost place where all four zones are free. With none, it stays in hand and the Spell hits its first target, as Joro already does on a full board. Lava Golem, which goes to the opponent when paid for with their Units, picks its zone the same single-zone way, and the same fix applies to it.

## Why
- `crates/engine/src/replacements.rs:802-806` (`answer_targeting`) picks Joro's zone with `zones::first_entry_zone`: one zone, with no GIGA fit check.
  - It takes the card out of the hand (`remove_from_any_zone`), then ignores the `bool` that `place_on_field` returns, and still pushes `summoned` and `redirected` naming the card.
  - `place_with` refuses a GIGA whose four zones are not all free (`zones.rs` around 750-757, R3546000). After that refusal the card is in no zone.
- The checks that decide whether Joro answers make the same one-zone assumption: `targeting.rs:136` (`first_entry_zone(..)?` before it looks for an interposer) and `play_choices.rs:1416` (`interceptor_fits_decl`).
- What the spec says:
  - §6.1's GIGA row: 'only fitting anchors are offered or summoned into'.
  - R394: Joro is summoned into the leftmost open unit zone, 'with none, nothing happens'.
- The engine already has a GIGA-aware choice: `giga::entry_anchor` (`giga.rs:121`), which `summon_existing` uses through `zone_and_stance_for` (`effects/summon.rs`, R3546002).
- Lava Golem has the same gap:
  - `handed_over_zone` (`play_steps.rs:842`) takes the named lane's zone if `is_open`, else `first_free_zone`, with no GIGA fit check.
  - When `place_on_field` refuses (`play_steps.rs:1707-1740`), the play goes on with `run.zone = None`.
  - R360 says a Golem with no room on the opponent's side lands where the play named it, on its player's side.
- Shipped cards reach it: C #33 Joro or Core #55 Lava Golem made GIGA in hand by S+ #100 Plesiosize or S+ #23 GIGA-ify, which keep the size onto the field (R1878003, R3546002). Neither card's tests nor `crates/engine/tests/rules/` test a GIGA Joro or a GIGA Golem.
- The same class was fixed twice lately: #4887 (Ticketed offered a GIGA it cannot stack on) and #4952 (a GIGA Tribute's four zones).

## Proposal
1. Add one helper for 'where this card would be summoned into its side's unit row': `giga::entry_anchor` for a card that `enters_giga`, otherwise `first_entry_zone`. Use it in `answer_targeting`, `targeting.rs:136` and `interceptor_fits_decl`, so the legal list, the AI and the answer cannot disagree.
2. In `answer_targeting`, take the card from the hand and push events only once the placement has succeeded. On a refusal, nothing answers.
3. In `handed_over_zone`, for a card that enters GIGA: use the named lane's anchor if it fits, else the opponent's `entry_anchor`, else `None` (R360's fallback: it stays where the play named it).
4. Add a ruling in the issue's block: for a GIGA Joro or Lava Golem, 'an open zone' means a fitting anchor (Hearthstone summons nothing that has no room). Put its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md` and name the proving tests after it.

## Where it lands
- `crates/engine/src/replacements.rs`, `targeting.rs`, `play_choices.rs`, `play_steps.rs`, and `giga.rs` or `zones.rs` for the helper
- Tests in `crates/engine/tests/rules/replacements.rs` and `tribute.rs`, or the cards' own tests in `classic/c033_joro.rs` and `core/c055_lava_golem.rs`
- `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/`; SPEC §6.1 GIGA, §6.2 Replacement, R394, R360, R3546000

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A GIGA Joro in hand with no fitting anchor on its side (every open unit zone has a set Trap behind it or is the rightmost lane): an enemy Spell targeting its owner's Unit is not redirected, Joro stays in hand, and the Spell resolves on its target. This test fails on main.
- [ ] A GIGA Joro with a fitting anchor to the right of a blocked open zone is summoned at that anchor, covering four zones, and the Spell is redirected to it.
- [ ] After any answer, the card that `summoned` names is on the field.
- [ ] In both cases above, the legal actions and the targeting-discard check agree with the answer.
- [ ] A GIGA base-face Lava Golem paid for with an enemy Tribute, where the opponent's zone in the named lane is open but does not fit: it lands at the opponent's fitting anchor, or where the play named it when they have none. It never goes to a graveyard.
- [ ] Existing Joro and Lava Golem tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` are green.

## Size and risks
Small to medium: four engine files, about six tests and one ruling. difficulty:hard (engine rules).

It changes how two shipped cards play in a rare position, so it takes a patch fragment (`--plays classic-033,core-055 --rule`). A recorded game that hit the old behaviour would fold differently; `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` will show any, and they keep the old behaviour per R767000. The non-GIGA path must stay exactly as it is, so no other recorded game moves.

## Goal

The decision the spec does not make (Hearthstone: a summon with no room never happens) ships as ruling R4990000 with its named tests.

| `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c055_lava_golem.rs` | change | Two `r4990000` card tests |

## Steps

1. Add the helper in `crates/engine/src/giga.rs` after `entry_anchor_where`: `pub fn summon_anchor(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId, card: &CardInstance) -> Option<ZoneSlot>` — if `enters_giga(state, card)` return `entry_anchor(state, player, Row::Units)`, else `crate::zones::first_entry_zone(state, player, Row::Units)`. Doc comment starts `/// R4990000:`. (`Row`, `ZoneSlot` are already imported; call `zones::first_entry_zone` by full path.)
2. In `crates/engine/src/replacements.rs`, `answer_targeting`: replace the `first_entry_zone(..)?` pick (lines ~800-806) with `let Some(slot) = crate::giga::summon_anchor(sink.state, defender, &card) else { continue; };`. Keep `remove_from_any_zone`, then change the bare `place_on_field(...)` call to `if !place_on_field(...) { card.zone = Zone::Hand { player: defender }; sink.state.players[defender].hand.push(card); continue; }` — add `Zone` to the line-31 `use crate::wire::{...}`. Push `summoned`/`Redirected`/Crater-lock only after a successful place (existing code, now correctly ordered). Rationale for `continue` over returning: a later candidate (a non-GIGA Joro) may still fit.
3. In `crates/engine/src/targeting.rs`, `interceptor_for`: delete the early `first_entry_zone(..)?` gate and extend the `find` predicate to `interposes_from_hand(state, card) && answers_source(state, card, source) && crate::giga::summon_anchor(state, defender, card).is_some()`. Non-GIGA behavior is identical (the helper returns `first_entry_zone` for them).
4. In `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs`, `interceptor_fits_decl`: replace `first_entry_zone(state, defender, Row::Units)` with the helper on the interceptor (`crate::giga::summon_anchor(state, defender, interceptor)`); the `probe` keeps `lane: zone.lane`. Nothing else in the function changes.
5. In `crates/engine/src/play_steps.rs`, `handed_over_zone`: after the `set_as` early return, insert the GIGA branch before the existing two: if `crate::giga::enters_giga(state, card)` and the run hands over (either `summon_for_opponent` or enemy-tribute handover), check the named lane's unit-row anchor with `crate::giga::fits(same_lane, \|s\| is_open(state, s))` and return it on fit; else return `crate::giga::entry_anchor(state, opponent, Row::Units)`; with neither, fall through to `None` (R360's stay-where-named fallback). Rejected alternative: entry-anchor-only (ignores the named lane), which contradicts the named-lane rule R360/R3546000 keep for GIGA summons. Step-1 zone validation is intentionally untouched: tests name lanes legal on the player's side.
6. Ruling: write `spec/rulings/R4990000.md` (front matter `id: R4990000`, title "A GIGA Joro or Lava Golem answers only where all four zones are free", `cards` naming `C #33`, `#55`, `§6.1`, `§6.2`, `R394`, `R360`, `R3546000`, `proven_in` listing the two card test files plus `crates/engine/tests/rules/replacements.rs`); write `spec/pending/4990.md` with one `**[[R4990000]] ... (issue #4990, 2026-11-26)**:` paragraph; append `[[R4990000]]` to the GIGA row's "A summon takes the leftmost fit … or a named lane that fits, else fails" sentence.
7. Run the `patches` command for `--plays classic-033,core-055 --rule` with a short title and `--source "#4990"`, then hand-write the `player` note in the generated fragment (`fixes`: what broke and now works; no ruling, issue, or card numbers and no `§`, per `patches check`).

## Tests

- `crates/engine/tests/rules/replacements.rs`, mod `e5_a_friendly_unit_is_targeted_e9_attack_redirect`, copying the direct-`answer_targeting` pattern at `the_play_pipelines_half_a_pick…`: grant GIGA with `live_mut(&mut state, &decoy.id).granted_keywords.push(jackioh_engine::wire::Keyword::Giga)` (`live_mut` is already imported; the fixture `joro` script has no `by`, so it answers). `r4990000_a_giga_interposer_with_no_fitting_anchor_answers_nothing_and_stays_in_hand`: p2 walls in unit lanes 1–4 (every anchor fails; lane 5 stays open so the old gate passes), assert `answer_targeting` returns `None`, no `Summoned`/`Redirected` events, decoy still in hand, and `jackioh_engine::targeting::interceptor_for(&state, P1, &target, None)` is `None`. This fails on main (card lost, bogus events). `r4990000_a_giga_interposer_answers_at_the_leftmost_fitting_anchor`: only the lane-1 wall, assert `Some`, the decoy stands in p2 unit lane 2, one `Redirected` from→to, and `interceptor_for` agrees.
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c033_joro.rs`, copying `under_attack` and using `crate::give_giga(&mut s, &joro_id)`: `r4990000_giga_with_no_fitting_anchor_stays_in_hand_and_the_spell_hits_its_target` (p1 units in lanes 1–4, enemy Hit Job at a unit: no redirect, Joro in hand, target destroyed) and `r4990000_giga_answers_at_the_leftmost_fitting_anchor_and_survives` (radiant Joro, one p1 unit in lane 1, enemy Eclipse: redirect to Joro, `summoned` lane 2, Joro on the field). These lock the agreed end-to-end behavior.
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c055_lava_golem.rs`, copying the `r360` module setups with `crate::give_giga` on the hand Golem: `r4990000_giga_base_paid_with_enemy_tribute_lands_at_the_opponent_s_fitting_anchor` (tributes p1 lanes 1–2 plus p2 lane 1, named zone 1, p2 lane 2 occupied: Golem controlled by p2 in lane 4) and `r4990000_giga_base_with_no_fit_on_the_opponent_s_side_stays_where_the_play_named_it` (p2 units in lanes 1–4: Golem stays p1 lane 1, controlled by p1). Both assert the Golem is on a field, never a graveyard. Both fail on main.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules r4990000`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c033_joro`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c055_lava_golem`, then the full card files' tests unfiltered, plus `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo jackioh spec check`. Confirm the fails-on-main tests fail on the base commit via an isolated `scripts/worktree.sh` worktree at `d1b9b808`, then remove that worktree.

## Done when

- [ ] GIGA Joro with no fitting anchor stays in hand and the Spell hits its target; with a fit it answers at the leftmost fitting anchor covering four zones.
- [ ] Every `summoned` names a card that is on the field afterward.
- [ ] `interceptor_for`/`interceptor_fits_decl` agree with the answer in both cases.
- [ ] GIGA Golem with an open-but-unfitting named lane lands at the opponent's fitting anchor, or where named when they have none; never a graveyard.
- [ ] Existing Joro and Lava Golem tests pass unchanged; fmt, clippy, and spec check are green; the patch fragment exists with a hand-written player note.

## Risks

- The issue text says a Spell loses a GIGA Joro through `answer_targeting`; the code does not do that — in production `answer_targeting` serves only attacks (combat.rs; a `by: "spell"` card never answers there), while Spell paths go through `intercept_targeting` plus the already GIGA-safe `summon_existing`, which fizzles cleanly. So the Joro card tests lock behavior rather than fail on main; the fails-on-main proof for that half is the direct `answer_targeting` unit test, and for the issue's acceptance items the Golem card tests. The `answer_targeting` fix is still required: it removes a real latent loss (any attack-answering interposer made GIGA) and unifies the gates.
- The restore-to-hand arm should be unreachable through the helper; if it ever fires, the hand order and an already-forgotten hand watch (R1140) are not restored — acceptable for a defensive path, and the unit test pins the order-independence.
- `handed_over_zone` runs after tributes are paid, so `is_open` already sees freed zones; no tribute-freed-zone special-casing was added. Step-1 offer validation is unchanged, so a GIGA Golem still needs a zone offered on the player's side as fallback.

## Open questions

None. All choices above are engine-owned; no person-only step (secret, dashboard, account) is needed.
```

# Plan (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, medium)

## Goal

A GIGA Joro in hand and a GIGA base-face Lava Golem handed over are summoned only where all four of their zones are free: they answer at the leftmost fitting anchor, and with none the Joro stays in hand (the Spell resolves on its original target) while the Golem stays where the play named it on its player's side, never a graveyard. One helper, `giga::summon_anchor`, makes the three Joro gates (`answer_targeting`, `interceptor_for`, `interceptor_fits_decl`) agree, and `handed_over_zone` gets the same fit check. The decision the spec does not make (Hearthstone: a summon with no room never happens) ships as ruling R4990000 with its named tests.
